name: Required Checks
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
      - name: Run rustfmt
        run: cargo fmt --check

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --all-features

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all-features

  docs:
    name: Documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Check documentation
        run: cargo doc --no-deps

  benchmarks:
    name: Benchmarks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run benchmarks
        run: cargo bench --all-features

  benchmarks-execute:
    name: Benchmark Execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: benchmarks
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Execute benchmarks
        run: cargo run --bin benchmark-runner --all-features

  vm:
    name: VM Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run VM tests
        run: cargo test --package vm --all-features

  cli:
    name: CLI Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run CLI tests
        run: cargo test --package cli --all-features

  primitives:
    name: Primitives Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run primitives tests
        run: cargo test --package primitives --all-features

  sdk:
    name: SDK Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run SDK tests
        run: cargo test --package sdk --all-features

  recursion:
    name: Recursion Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run recursion tests
        run: cargo test --package recursion --all-features

  extension-tests:
    name: Extension Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run extension tests
        run: cargo test --package extension-tests --all-features

  riscv:
    name: RISC-V Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run RISC-V tests
        run: cargo test --package riscv --all-features

  guest-lib-tests:
    name: Guest Library Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run guest library tests
        run: cargo test --package guest-lib-tests --all-features

  native-compiler:
    name: Native Compiler Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run native compiler tests
        run: cargo test --package native-compiler --all-features
